_comment: Clek-compatible stroller fragment (batch S6 Silver Cross). Sourced 2026-07-05. Silver Cross Dune (compact urban modular). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Silver Cross Dune

clekListed.clekRow: Silver Cross Dune — Dune/Reef Car Seat Adapters

specs._weightNote: ~15.3 lb chassis + ~10 lb seat = ~25.3 lb combined (retailer spec).
specs._dimsNote: Open ~30 x 23 x 36-42.5 in; folded ~27 x 23 x 11 in, free-standing (folds forward or rearward). From Mega Babies / retailer spec.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: birth (reversible lie-flat seat, works from newborn out of the box)

safety.standards: Not published on US spec pages. Silver Cross is UK-origin (EN 1888 home market); US units must meet ASTM F833 / 16 CFR 1227 but no specific cert is stated by brand/retailer.
safety.notes: 5-point harness; reversible seat; one-hand self-standing compact fold; shell/fabrics use recycled plastic.

specs.foldType: one-hand self-standing compact fold (folds both forward- and rear-facing)

notes: Dune is being superseded by the Reef 2 / Dune 2 generation — the Silver Cross US Dune URL now redirects to the Reef 2 (discontinued on DTC), but Nordstrom, Albee Baby and Bambi Baby still carry it. Price $959.99 is the widely-cited launch/MSRP; reconfirm at checkout as this is a wind-down SKU. Clek Liing mounts via the shared Dune/Reef car seat adapters ($59.99).
